mgcv_smooth_family_crossings.scope: Every regular mgcv smooth crossed with binomial, Poisson and Gamma responses at fixed smoothing, with seven-stage checks and strict observable EDF/likelihood/uncertainty/residual invariants. The common probe restores upstream Newton behavior in-process.

mgcv_k_check_shared_plan.scope: Seven smooth structures crossed with three non-Gaussian families and two subsampling policies. Python and the actual R k.check body share selected rows and 37 permutations; only sample() is supplied to R. Tight full-table comparison includes permutation probabilities, tensor rescaling and undefined categorical diagnostics. The common probe restores upstream Newton behavior in-process.

mgcv_cox_fixed.scope: Native fixed-smoothing Cox linear/smooth/categorical/stratified endpoints, tied event/censor risk sets, offsets, absolute survival and coefficient covariance functionals. Automatic smoothing and baseline/curve inference are unsupported.

qgam_calfast_fixed.scope: qgam ELF fixed bandwidth/fixed penalty calFast scalar calibration: four-scale criterion, posterior/sandwich prediction variances and optimized endpoints at k=4 and shrinkage-active k=10. Automatic bandwidth/smoothing and bootstrap calibration are unsupported.

survival_longitudinal.scope: R glm Poisson weighted terminal-event changing-covariate likelihood and supplied-trajectory predictions with independent model/record boundaries. No recurrent-event, parametric longitudinal or trajectory bootstrap inference is claimed.

survival_temporal.scope: Fixed/REML weighted delayed-entry and offset PEM temporal ti(survival_time,x) endpoints, full k=5 baseline on five endpoints and matched tight inner/outer convergence.

cox_smoothing.scope: Coupled Cox automatic REML fitted endpoints: unstratified Newton/BFGS and stratified BFGS. Stratified Newton remains unsupported.

cox_uncertainty.scope: Baseline q/a and coxpred standard errors; raw Schoenfeld and score processes. Raw source martingale/deviance retain recorded stratified indexing quirks.

cox_diagnostics_consistent.scope: Direct source baseline hazard/stratum lookup with original predictors, isolating source fitted-value indexing and varying-offset query-ordering quirks.

qgam_bandwidth.scope: Source residual SHASH estimate and three bandwidth levels. Flat nuisance coordinates are not identifiable endpoints.

qgam_adaptive_bandwidth.scope: Nonlinear initial Gaussian REML variance, penalty EDF, standardized residuals and SHASH bandwidth.

qgam_calfast_auto.scope: Scale-profile REML selection and calibrated endpoints; oversmoothing-limit SP coordinates need not be identified.

qgam_calfast_auto_nonlinear.scope: Nonlinear scale-profile REML selection, calibrated functions/covariance and identified finite smoothing endpoint.

boxcox_moments.scope: Independent response-space integrals of BCT/BCPE densities for finite moments; no fitting capability implied.

normal_observations.scope: Independent normalized normal likelihood with exact, left/right and interval censoring inside fixed truncation. Not a claim of matching mgcv cnorm parameterization.

survival_smooth_baseline.scope: Fixed/REML weighted delayed-entry and offset PEM with full k=5 baseline on five endpoints and matched tight inner/outer convergence.
